138  async def follow_agent_run(
  139      workspace_id: UUID,
  140      run_id: UUID,
  141      request: Request,
  142      after_sequence: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
  143      context: WorkspaceExecutionContext = context_dependency,
  144  ) -> StreamingResponse:
  145      """Attach to a run this connection did not start.
  146  
  147      The POST endpoint starts a run; this one follows it. A client that drops
  148      its connection reconnects here with the last ``sequence`` it saw and
  149      receives everything it missed from the durable event log before rejoining
  150      the live stream, so a reload or a network blip costs frames, not the run.
  151      """
  152  
  153      del workspace_id
  154      service = _service(request)
  155      stream = service.attach_stream(context, run_id=run_id, after_sequence=after_sequence)
  156      return StreamingResponse(
  157          _sse_frames(stream, request),
  158          media_type="text/event-stream",
  159          headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"},
  160      )

1  """Explicit composition adapter for the opt-in Onyx source-section selector.
    2  
    3  Opt-in only: no default composition installs this wrapper. The wrapped
    4  retriever still owns snapshot scope, hydration, lifecycle penalties, floor
    5  and dedup. Any selector failure falls back to the exact original ranking and
    6  budget selection, marked in the trace -- the fallback never fabricates a
    7  successful selection.
    8  """
    9  
   10  from __future__ import annotations
   11  
   12  import asyncio
   13  import math
   14  import time
   15  from dataclasses import asdict, replace
   16  
   17  from packages.core.execution_context.call_scope import (
   18      auxiliary_model_attempt,
   19      remaining_call_seconds,
   20      unpriced_auxiliary_calls_allowed,
   21  )
   22  from packages.core.execution_context.models import WorkspaceExecutionContext
   23  from packages.knowledge.adapters.onyx_selection import (
   24      SectionSelectorError,
   25      promote_evidence,
   26      sections_from_evidence,
   27  )
   28  from packages.knowledge.context_selection import select_budgeted_records
   29  from packages.knowledge.contracts import (
   30      KnowledgeRetriever,
   31      RetrievalQuery,
   32      RetrievalResult,
   33      RetrievalTraceResult,
   34      RetrievalTraceStage,
   35      SectionSelector,
   36  )
   37  
   38  
   39  class OnyxSelectionKnowledgeRetriever:
   40      """Promote source groups a section-selection model chose, or fall back.
   41  
   42      The inner call fetches the candidate-sized pool under the SAME
   43      query/snapshot/floor/dedup semantics; only the final ordering and the
   44      count/byte cut happen here, exactly like the joint-evidence combinator.
   45      """
   46  
   47      def __init__(
   48          self,
   49          retriever: KnowledgeRetriever,
   50          selector: SectionSelector | None,
   51      ) -> None:
   52          self.retriever = retriever
   53          self.selector = selector
   54  
   55      async def retrieve_with_trace(
   56          self, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, query: RetrievalQuery
   57      ) -> RetrievalResult:
   58          if (
   59              type(query.final_top_k) is not int
   60              or not 1 <= query.final_top_k <= 10
   61              or type(query.candidate_top_k) is not int
   62              or not 1 <= query.candidate_top_k <= 20
   63              or type(query.context_budget_bytes) is not int
   64              or not 2 <= query.context_budget_bytes <= 64_000
   65              or query.evidence_projection is not None
   66          ):
   67              raise ValueError("onyx selection requires its bounded original-record profile")
   68          pool = await self.retriever.retrieve_with_trace(
   69              context, replace(query, final_top_k=query.candidate_top_k, context_budget_bytes=None)
   70          )
   71          if not pool.evidence:
   72              return pool
   73          started = time.perf_counter()
   74          selected: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
   75          fallback_reason: str | None = None
   76          attempt = None
   77          if self.selector is None:
   78              fallback_reason = "unconfigured"
   79          elif not unpriced_auxiliary_calls_allowed():
   80              # The selector has no frozen price contract. A capped Run must not
   81              # dispatch an extra unpriced model call behind its cost guard.
   82              fallback_reason = "cost_budget_unpriced_selector"
   83          else:
   84              try:
   85                  sections = sections_from_evidence(pool.evidence)
   86                  remaining = remaining_call_seconds()
   87                  # The candidate pool already exists: reserve time to deliver
   88                  # that fallback instead of letting the outer tool cancel it.
   89                  budget = float(getattr(self.selector, "timeout_seconds", 30.0))
   90                  if not math.isfinite(budget) or budget <= 0:
   91                      raise ValueError("invalid selector timeout")
   92                  if remaining is not None:
   93                      budget = min(budget, max(0.0, remaining - 0.1))
   94                  if budget <= 0:
   95                      raise TimeoutError
   96                  with auxiliary_model_attempt(
   97                      source="onyx_selector",
   98                      provider="openai-compatible",
   99                      model=getattr(self.selector, "model", None),
  100                  ) as attempt:
  101                      try:
  102                          async with asyncio.timeout(budget):
  103                              selected = await self.selector.select_sections(
  104                                  context, query.text, sections
  105                              )
  106                          attempt["attempt_status"] = "SUCCEEDED"
  107                      except TimeoutError:
  108                          attempt["attempt_status"] = "UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT"
  109                          raise
  110                  ranked = promote_evidence(pool.evidence, sections, selected)
  111              except TimeoutError:
  112                  selected, fallback_reason = None, "selector_deadline"
  113              except SectionSelectorError as exc:
  114                  if attempt is not None:
  115                      attempt["attempt_status"] = "FAILED"
  116                  selected, fallback_reason = None, f"selector_failed:{type(exc).__name__}"
  117              except ValueError as exc:
  118                  if attempt is not None:
  119                      attempt["attempt_status"] = "FAILED"
  120                  # A malformed selection output surfaces as ValueError from
  121                  # strict parsing; a malformed pool must not leak either.
  122                  selected, fallback_reason = None, f"invalid_selection:{exc.__class__.__name__}"
  123          if selected is None:
  124              ranked = pool.evidence
  125          elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
  126          records = select_budgeted_records(
  127              [asdict(item) for item in ranked],
  128              max_bytes=query.context_budget_bytes,
  129              max_items=query.final_top_k,
  130          )
  131          kept_ids = {record["chunk_id"] for record in records}
  132          evidence = tuple(item for item in ranked if item.chunk_id in kept_ids)
  133          return RetrievalResult(
  134              evidence,
  135              replace(
  136                  pool.trace,
  137                  total_latency_ms=pool.trace.total_latency_ms + elapsed,
  138                  evidence_set=RetrievalTraceStage(
  139                      elapsed,
  140                      tuple(
  141                          RetrievalTraceResult(
  142                              item.chunk_id,
  143                              rank,
  144                              item.rerank_score
  145                              if item.rerank_score is not None
  146                              else item.retrieval_score,
  147                          )
  148                          for rank, item in enumerate(evidence, 1)
  149                      ),
  150                      {
  151                          "selector": "onyx_v1",
  152                          "status": "selected" if selected is not None else "fallback",
  153                          **({"reason": fallback_reason} if fallback_reason else {}),
  154                          "candidate_count": len(pool.evidence),
  155                          **({"selected_sections": len(selected)} if selected is not None else {}),
  156                          "admitted_count": len(evidence),
  157                          "order": "original_relevance",
  158                          **({"model_usage": attempt} if attempt is not None else {}),
  159                      },
  160                  ),
  161              ),
  162          )
  163  
  164  
  165  __all__ = ["OnyxSelectionKnowledgeRetriever"]

238      async def add_variant(
  239          self,
  240          session: AsyncSession,
  241          *,
  242          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  243          experiment_id: UUID,
  244          label: str,
  245          agent_version_id: UUID,
  246          pricing_snapshot_id: UUID,
  247          ordinal: int,
  248          variant_metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
  249      ) -> EvaluationExperimentVariant:
  250          self._require_permission(context, EVALUATION_MANAGE)
  251          experiment = await self.get_experiment(
  252              session, context=context, experiment_id=experiment_id, for_update=True
  253          )
  254          self._require_draft(experiment)
  255          normalized_label = self._required_text(label, "label", code="EVALUATION_VARIANT_INVALID")
  256          if ordinal < 0 or ordinal >= 5:
  257              raise AgentHubError(
  258                  "EVALUATION_VARIANT_INVALID", "ordinal must be between 0 and 4.", 422
  259              )
  260          current_count = await session.scalar(
  261              select(func.count(EvaluationExperimentVariant.id)).where(
  262                  EvaluationExperimentVariant.workspace_id == experiment.workspace_id,
  263                  EvaluationExperimentVariant.experiment_id == experiment.id,
  264              )
  265          )
  266          if current_count >= 5:
  267              raise AgentHubError(
  268                  "EVALUATION_VARIANT_LIMIT",
  269                  "An experiment may contain at most five variants.",
  270                  422,
  271              )
  272          metadata = validate_variant_metadata(
  273              variant_metadata if variant_metadata is not None else {}
  274          )
  275          agent_version = await self._load_agent_version(
  276              session, experiment.workspace_id, agent_version_id
  277          )
  278          pricing_snapshot = await session.scalar(
  279              select(PricingSnapshot).where(
  280                  PricingSnapshot.workspace_id == experiment.workspace_id,
  281                  PricingSnapshot.id == pricing_snapshot_id,
  282              )
  283          )
  284          if pricing_snapshot is None:
  285              raise AgentHubError(
  286                  "EVALUATION_PRICING_NOT_FOUND",
  287                  "The pricing snapshot was not found.",
  288                  404,
  289              )
  290          pricing_hash = reproducibility_module.pricing_snapshot_content_hash(pricing_snapshot)
  291          if pricing_hash != pricing_snapshot.content_hash:
  292              raise AgentHubError(
  293                  "EVALUATION_PRICING_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  294                  "The pricing snapshot content hash is invalid.",
  295                  422,
  296              )
  297          self._validate_pricing_model(agent_version.resolved_spec, pricing_snapshot)
  298          try:
  299              parsed = parse_frozen_agent_spec(
  300                  agent_version.resolved_spec,
  301                  workspace_id=experiment.workspace_id,
  302              )
  303              metadata, fallback_snapshot_ids = consume_fallback_pricing_request(
  304                  metadata,
  305                  parsed.model_plan,
  306                  primary_snapshot_id=pricing_snapshot.id,
  307              )
  308              pricing_snapshots = await load_pricing_snapshots(
  309                  session,
  310                  workspace_id=experiment.workspace_id,
  311                  snapshot_ids=(pricing_snapshot.id, *fallback_snapshot_ids),
  312              )
  313              metadata = build_frozen_pricing_chain(
  314                  metadata,
  315                  parsed.model_plan,
  316                  pricing_snapshots,
  317              )
  318          except (AgentHubError, PricingChainError) as error:
  319              raise self._pricing_chain_error(error) from None
  320          snapshots = await self._freeze_knowledge(
  321              session, context, experiment.workspace_id, agent_version.resolved_spec
  322          )
  323          wiki_publications = await self._freeze_wiki_publications(
  324              session,
  325              context,
  326              experiment.workspace_id,
  327              agent_version.resolved_spec,
  328          )
  329          frozen_variant_hash = variant_hash(
  330              agent_version_id=str(agent_version.id),
  331              resolved_spec_hash=agent_version.resolved_spec_hash,
  332              effective_knowledge_snapshots=snapshots,
  333              pricing_snapshot_id=str(pricing_snapshot.id),
  334              pricing_snapshot_hash=pricing_hash,
  335              variant_metadata=metadata,
  336              effective_wiki_publications=wiki_publications,
  337          )
  338          variant = EvaluationExperimentVariant(
  339              workspace_id=experiment.workspace_id,
  340              experiment_id=experiment.id,
  341              label=normalized_label,
  342              agent_version_id=agent_version.id,
  343              resolved_spec_hash=agent_version.resolved_spec_hash,
  344              pricing_snapshot_id=pricing_snapshot.id,
  345              pricing_snapshot_hash=pricing_hash,
  346              effective_knowledge_snapshots=snapshots,
  347              effective_wiki_publications=wiki_publications,
  348              variant_metadata=metadata,
  349              variant_hash=frozen_variant_hash,
  350              ordinal=ordinal,
  351          )
  352          session.add(variant)
  353          try:
  354              await session.commit()
  355          except IntegrityError as exc:
  356              await session.rollback()
  357              raise AgentHubError(
  358                  "EVALUATION_VARIANT_CONFLICT",
  359                  "The variant label or ordinal is already used by this experiment.",
  360                  409,
  361              ) from exc
  362          return variant
